project_warning_origins.source: legacy shim imports and CLI aliases

dependency_warning_origins.known_issue: PendingDeprecationWarning on legacy import multipart / multipart.multipart
dependency_warning_origins.status: closed in project runtime by local src/multipart shim
dependency_warning_origins.action: do not remove shim or bump FastAPI/Starlette inside business refactor; review only in dedicated dependency upgrade iteration

dependency_warning_origins.known_issue: pytest/plugin/import warnings may appear from site-packages/ddtrace in some environments
dependency_warning_origins.action: upgrade only if warning is reproducible in clean targeted gates and isolated to dependency origin

upgrade_in_separate_change_when: warning origin is dependency/site-packages rather than project code
warning is reproducible in targeted pytest/smoke gates
upstream fix or safer supported version is known
upgrade can be validated with pytest, smoke and verify_refactor without changing business behavior
document_only_when: warning is not reproducible in current targeted gates
warning is already neutralized by a compatibility shim without business-impact change
upgrade would mix dependency churn with business refactor or compatibility work
upstream has no clear fix or upgrade risk is higher than operational value
